transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile customer service. My name is Marcus. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Marcus. I'm calling because my mobile phone internet has suddenly become unusable over the last forty-eight hours. Speed tests show only zero point five megabits per second, even though I pay for an Unlimited 5G Max SIM plan! I live in a static residential caravan in rural Cumbria where there is no fixed broadband line at all, so this mobile connection is my only lifeline to the outside world!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand how frustrating it is when your primary internet connection slows down, especially when living in a rural area where mobile data is your only lifeline, and I can certainly look into that sudden speed reduction for you. Can you please confirm the mobile telephone number you are calling about?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And what are the last four digits of the SIM card number printed on your plastic card or invoice?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The last four digits are 9104.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So if I have understood correctly, your Unlimited 5G mobile data speed has dropped dramatically to zero point five megabits per second over the past two days, impacting your sole internet access at your rural property, and you need high-speed throughput restored. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. Webpages take two minutes to load and I cannot stream any news or weather forecasts.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Looking at your cellular billing telemetry, your account has consumed six hundred and forty-eight gigabytes of mobile data over the past ten days of your billing cycle.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Six hundred and forty-eight gigabytes! How could that be possible?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under S-Net's Fair Usage Policy for consumer unlimited mobile plans, accounts exceeding six hundred gigabytes within a single calendar month are classified as excessive commercial usage.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Commercial usage? I am not a business! I am just a single person living in a caravan!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When the six hundred gigabyte fair usage threshold is breached, our automated traffic management gateway applies an automatic bandwidth ceiling of five hundred and twelve kilobits per second.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why does S-Net advertise the contract as 'Unlimited Data' if you restrict it at six hundred gigabytes? That is completely misleading advertising!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The data allowance remains unmetered and unlimited in volume, but bandwidth transmission speed is managed during peak network congestion to protect local cell mast capacity.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Could my computer have downloaded large software updates in the background without me knowing?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Large Windows operating system updates, cloud storage backups, or continuous high-definition video streaming via mobile hotspot can rapidly accumulate hundreds of gigabytes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh my goodness... my grandson visited last weekend and connected his gaming laptop to my mobile hotspot to download several new games!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Modern gaming downloads regularly exceed one hundred gigabytes per game title.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That explains the massive spike! He must have downloaded four or five massive game updates over the weekend!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That aligns precisely with the three hundred and eighty gigabyte spike recorded on Saturday and Sunday.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Now that we know it was an accidental one-off event, can you lift this five hundred kilobit throttle so I can use my internet again?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under our customer care guidelines, a customer service representative can grant a one-time fair usage policy speed reset once every twelve months.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please, I would be so grateful if you could apply that reset!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am submitting the FUP Throttle Removal request to our mobile network operations team right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long does it take for the speed cap to clear?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The operational ticket clears through the HLR gateway within two hours, after which you simply restart your handset to regain full 5G speeds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is wonderful news.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also set up data usage alerts on your phone so you receive warning text messages before reaching critical thresholds in future.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, where do we configure those text alerts?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have activated automated SMS usage notifications on your account at four hundred gigabytes and five hundred gigabytes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will give me plenty of advance warning if my grandson visits again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can also set a password on your personal hotspot and change it after visitors leave to prevent unmetered background leeching.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will change the hotspot password this afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check the Access Point Name profile on your handset to make sure network routing is prioritized.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Where on the phone is the Access Point Name menu?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under Settings, Mobile Service, Mobile Data Network, ensure APN is set to 'mobile.s-net.co.uk' with IP type set to IPv4/IPv6 Dual Stack.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Checking Mobile Data Network... APN is indeed mobile.s-net.co.uk, and Dual Stack is enabled.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms the device has native routing for both modern web protocols and legacy IP servers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: When does my regular monthly billing cycle reset for data allowance?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your billing cycle resets automatically on the twenty-fourth of each month, in nine days' time, dropping the counter back to zero gigabytes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So on the twenty-fourth, everything starts fresh with full high-speed data?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Do you also have a fixed broadband telephone line at this property that you could connect your laptop to?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Marcus, as I explained at the very start of this call, I live in a rural residential caravan in Cumbria where there is no fixed telephone or broadband line whatsoever! That is why my mobile is my only internet!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I apologize, I wanted to double-check whether alternative local physical wiring had been installed recently.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, there are no wires across these fields. Mobile data is our only option.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. For rural residents requiring heavy continuous household bandwidth, S-Net also offers a dedicated 4G and 5G Home Broadband router with an external antenna.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How does the 5G Home Broadband router differ from a mobile phone SIM?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Home Broadband plan carries a one-terabyte fair usage threshold and higher radio priority on rural transmission masts.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That might be very worthwhile for me to look into if my data needs increase.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can send an information brochure on our 5G Rural Broadband tariffs to your registered email address.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, please email that over so I can read through it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have dispatched the product summary guide to your email.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Marcus.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check the signal reception bars in your caravan to ensure the phone is locking onto our 5G tower rather than falling back to 3G.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Looking at the top of the phone screen... it displays three bars of 5G by the south window, but only two bars near the kitchen area.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Caravan aluminum cladding can attenuate high-frequency 5G radio waves by up to twenty decibels; keeping the handset near the south window provides optimal signal reception.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will make sure to keep the phone in the window dock when tethering to the laptop.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously that confirms your baseline consumer mobile profile will remain fully protected from inadvertent fair usage restrictions in future.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That gives me much greater confidence going forward.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will remain the dedicated owner for this support enquiry and monitor the FUP reset ticket until full speed is restored.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for getting the speed reset approved so quickly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Remember to toggle Airplane Mode on and off or restart your phone at one o'clock to connect to the unthrottled carrier profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will restart the phone at one o'clock sharp.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your S-Net mobile plan or data allowance that I can assist you with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that has sorted my data problem completely. Thank you Marcus.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You may receive a short customer satisfaction survey by SMS after this call; we would appreciate any feedback on our call today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will give you top marks on the survey. Good afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Have a wonderful day and take care.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, goodbye.
